scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS): Scheme For Reimbursement Of Stamp Duty
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Unit must be a new or existing manufacturing or service unit undertaking expansion/diversification in the MSME sector
Unit must have commenced commercial production between 20 May 2022 and 19 May 2027
Unit must be located in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
Reimbursement is payable only after purchase of land and development of at least 25% of the required infrastructure
benefits_summary: Provides reimbursement of stamp duty up to 100% (50% for MSMEs, 25% for non‑MSMEs, 100% for thrust sectors, and 50% for units in industrial parks).
